shortDescription: Adds a new Cloud App Control rule.

options.name: actions
options.description: Actions allowed for the specified type.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: applications
options.description: List of cloud applications for which rule will be applied

options.name: cascading_enabled
options.description: Enforce the URL Filtering policy on a transaction, even after it is explicitly allowed by the Cloud App Control policy. The URL Filtering policy does not apply if the transaction is blocked by the Cloud App Control policy.

options.name: cbi_profile
options.description: The cloud browser isolation profile to which the ISOLATE action is applied in the Cloud App Control Policy rules. This parameter is required for the ISOLATE action and is not applicable to other actions.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cloud_app_instances
options.description: Name-ID pair of Cloud application instances for which rule will be applied.

options.name: cloud_app_risk_profile
options.description: Name-ID pair of cloud Application Risk Profile for which rule will be applied.

options.name: departments
options.description: Name-ID pairs of departments for which rule will be applied

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule

options.name: device_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: device_trust_levels
options.description: List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: devices
options.description: Name-ID pairs of devices for which rule must be applied. Specifies devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether the Cloud App Control rule is enabled or disabled

options.name: enforce_time_validity
options.description: Enforce a set a validity time period for the Cloud App Control rule.

options.name: groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of groups for which rule must be applied

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the Cloud App Control policy rule

options.name: labels
options.description: The Cloud App Control rule label. Rule labels allow you to logically group your organization policy rules. Policy rules that are not associated with a rule label are grouped under the Untagged label.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: Name-ID pairs of the location groups to which the rule must be applied.

options.name: locations
options.description: Name-ID pairs of locations for which rule must be applied

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Cloud App Control policy rule

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number of the Cloud App Control policy rule

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

options.name: rule_type
options.description: The rule type selected from the available options.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: size_quota
options.description: Action must be set to CAUTION Size quota in MB beyond which the Cloud App Control rule is applied. The allowed range is between 10 MB and 100000 MB If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to BLOCK, this field is not applicable.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: tenancy_profile_ids
options.description: Name-ID pair of Tenant Profile for which rule will be applied.

options.name: time_quota
options.description: Action must be set to CAUTION Time quota in minutes, after which the Cloud App Control rule is applied. The allowed range is between 15 minutes and 600 minutes. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to BLOCK, this field is not applicable.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: Name-ID pairs of time interval during which rule must be enforced.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: user_agent_types
options.description: Any number of user agents to which the rule applies.

options.name: user_risk_score_levels
options.description: Indicates the user risk level selected for the DLP rule violation.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: Name-ID pairs of users for which rule must be applied

options.name: validity_end_time
options.description: If enforce_time_validity is set to true, the Cloud App Control rule will cease to be valid on this end date and time. Example ( 12/21/2023 12:00 AM )

options.name: validity_start_time
options.description: If enforce_time_validity is set to true, the Cloud App Control rule will be valid starting on this date and time. Example ( 11/20/2023 11:59 PM ) Notice that validity_start_time cannot be in the past

options.name: validity_time_zone_id
options.description: If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the Cloud App Control rule date and time is valid based on this time zone ID.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
